[b][color=#00ff00]How to get SMAPI Error Log？
[/color][/b][list]
[*]Press [code]Windows + R[/code]
 to open the Run dialog.[*]Type [code]%appdata%\StardewValley\ErrorLogs[/code] and press Enter.
[/list]

Tired of digging through giant SMAPI logs just to figure out [i]what broke this time[/i]?
SMAPI Log Doctor is a simple desktop helper that reads your SMAPI log and turns it into a clean, human-friendly report.
Open your log → get a health check in seconds.[center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FTUKgGq.png[/img][/center]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=3]What it does[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]🔴 [b]Shows broken / skipped mods[/b]
[list]
[*]Failed to load, missing manifest, missing required mods, wrong folder, etc.
[/list][*]⚠️ [b]Highlights risky & “heavy” mods[/b]
[list]
[*]Save-serializer changers, direct game patchers, console access
[*]Good first suspects when your game starts crashing
[/list][*]⬆️ [b]Lists mods with updates available[/b]
[list]
[*][code]Mod Name – current → latest[/code] based on SMAPI’s own update check
[/list][*]💡 [b]Gives plain-language suggestions[/b]
[list]
[*]“Install this dependency”, “Move this folder”, “Be careful removing this mod”, etc.
[/list][*]🌐 [b]13 different languages toggle[/b]
[list]
[*]One button switches [b]all UI + suggestions[/b] between multiple languages.
